name: pacing
description: Use better models and still save weekly usage at the same time by delegating easier work to subagents with cheaper models. This skill spends your weekly plan allowance on purpose. It uses tiers of models, the top tier is used for the most difficult work; the lower tiers do easier work through subagents. A day-by-day budget and the logged trend decide how far down the tiers work goes, so the week never runs out before the reset. That means it uses better models automatically when you have more usage left. You can custom set how many tiers you want and what model and effort should be on every tier.
